english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a kind, loving person.
Use this when sweetheart praises someone as an especially kind person rather than identifying a lover.
Use this for a plain description of someone as a good or kind person rather than the affectionate or idealized praise of 天使.
Use 好人 when someone is called “a good sort.”

examples.english: They’re such a dear, always helping people.
examples.traditional: 佢真係個好人，成日幫人。
